Sectoare de activitate: Servicii IT și consultanță IT, Servicii financiare și Servicii de inginerie
About Prime Engineering: 
 Prime Engineering Romania is part of the international Prime ecosystem (Prime Group), a growing technology and engineering organization with over 19 years of experience and more than 2,430 professionals worldwide. With a strong international presence across Europe and beyond, Prime Engineering delivers expertise across Engineering, IT and Telecom, supporting clients through Team Extension, Managed Services, Nearshore, Team-as-a-Service and custom solutions.
 About the Role: 
 Currently, we are looking for a Senior .NET / Azure Developer for one of our international clients. This is a key role for an experienced software engineer who will join a highly skilled and collaborative international development team, working on complex software solutions within a technology-driven environment.
 Responsibilities: 
Design, develop and deliver high-quality, scalable software solutions using .NET and C#
Take ownership of software development activities, from understanding requirements and designing solutions through development, testing and deployment
Collaborate with product owners, business users and other developers to translate user stories into clear and deliverable technical solutions
Apply software architecture principles, including SOLID principles and design patterns, to build maintainable and scalable applications
Develop and maintain REST APIs and services supporting integration between different systems
Work with Microsoft Azure and contribute to cloud-based application development and architecture
Build, maintain and improve CI/CD pipelines using Azure DevOps and modern DevOps practices
Work with event-driven architectures and event streaming technologies, ideally Kafka
Leverage AI and agentic engineering tools responsibly in day-to-day development activities and engineering workflows to improve productivity and software quality
Participate in TDD, pair programming, code reviews and other agile engineering practices
Investigate and resolve software defects and production issues
Contribute to application maintenance, technical improvements and continuous optimization
Support application deployments, monitoring, data migration and UAT activities
Participate in performance, load, stress, scale and security testing
Contribute to third-line application support when required
Continuously evaluate new technologies, development approaches and tools that could improve the technology landscape
Work closely with international development teams and contribute to a culture of knowledge sharing and continuous improvement
 Qualifications: 
Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering or a related field is preferred
Relevant technical certifications are a plus
 Minimum 3 years of hands-on experience in software engineering , with a strong focus on .NET technologies
Strong proficiency in C# and .NET
Solid experience with Microsoft Azure and cloud fundamentals
Practical experience with Azure DevOps, CI/CD and modern DevOps practices
Experience with containerization and ideally Kubernetes (K8s)
Experience with event-driven architectures (EDA) and event streaming platforms, ideally Kafka
Strong understanding of software architecture, SOLID principles and design patterns
Proven experience developing and maintaining REST APIs
Experience delivering high-quality, unit-tested software in a commercial environment
Experience with TDD, automated testing, code reviews and agile development practices
Hands-on experience with AI fundamentals and/or AI-enabled development tools
Experience using agentic engineering tools responsibly in software development is a strong plus
Good understanding of Git/GitOps and modern software delivery practices
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills
Excellent communication skills in English, both written and spoken
Ability to work effectively within distributed, international teams
Creative and structured approach to problem solving
Enthusiasm for continuous learning and knowledge sharing
 Nice to have: 
Experience with SQL Server and stored procedures
Experience with Azure Functions
Experience with Azure AI or other cloud-based AI services
Knowledge of financial services, banking or financial technology environments
Exposure to FX systems or financial markets is an advantage
Experience working with financial systems or regulated environments
 Salary: >331,884 RON gross per year .
 Contract Type: Full-time, Permanent Contract
 Location: Bucharest | Hybrid system (3 days/week), with flexibility
 Working hours: Monday–Friday, 08:00/09:30–17:00/18:30
 Equal Opportunity Statement: 
 Prime Engineering Romania is committed to creating a diverse and inclusive environment and is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to characteristics such as race, color, religion, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, genetics or any other characteristic protected by applicable law.
